Today, we’re road tripping across the Olympic Peninsula to the far western reaches of the Lower 48. Out here, we’ll meet locals in old boatbuilding towns, explore historic forts and deep logging country, and hear some wild Sasquatch stories along the way. Join me as we venture into one of the most beautiful and mysterious corners of America.
